situation.title: Hormuz closure for 4 months with a weaker global economy
situation.narrative: Analyst brief: Houthi strikes widen to tanker traffic; Hormuz transits fall sharply from November. US data soften. Question: which risks for India cross critical thresholds, and does a 50% pump-price pass-through change the picture?
